    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Interview invitation" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Participant_Candidates" messageRef="Message_InterviewInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Preference" name="Interview preference" sourceRef="Participant_Candidates" targetRef="Event_ReceivePreference" messageRef="Message_InterviewPreference"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Offer" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Participant_Candidates" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NegotiationRequest" name="Negotiation request" sourceRef="Participant_Candidates" targetRef="Event_ReceiveNegotiationRequest" messageRef="Message_NegotiationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Offer acceptance" sourceRef="Participant_Candidates" targetRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_NegotiatedAcceptance" name="Offer acceptance" sourceRef="Participant_Candidates" targetRef="Event_ReceiveNegotiatedAcceptance" messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Hiring" name="Hiring and onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_NeedIdentified" name="Need for a new hire identified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="Create job description"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostJobDescription" name="Post job description on job boards"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_CollectResumes" name="Collect resumes" messageRef="Message_Resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScreenResumes" name="Screen resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterviews" name="Conduct initial phone interviews"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewSelection" name="Candidates selected for interviews?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoInterviewSelection" name="No candidates selected"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InviteCandidates" name="Invite selected candidates" messageRef="Message_InterviewInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceivePreference" name="Receive interview preference">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_InterviewPreference" messageRef="Message_InterviewPreference"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewFormat" name="Interview format"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Merge interview formats"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CandidateChosen" name="Candidate chosen?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoCandidateChosen" name="No candidate chosen"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_OfferResponse" name="Wait for offer response"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive offer acceptance">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Acceptance" messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveNegotiationRequest" name="Receive negotiation request">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_NegotiationRequest" messageRef="Message_NegotiationRequest"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Negotiate salary"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveNegotiatedAcceptance" name="Receive offer acceptance after negotiation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_NegotiatedAcceptance" messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete paperwork"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductOrientation" name="Conduct orientation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FullyIntegrated" name="New hire fully integrated into the team"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_PostJobDescription" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterviews" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewSelection"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Candidates selected" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSelection" targetRef="Task_InviteCandidates">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${candidatesSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="No candidates selected" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSelection" targetRef="End_NoInterviewSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not candidatesSelected}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Event_ReceivePreference"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Event_ReceivePreference" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="In-person preference" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${preference == 'inPerson'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Virtual preference" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${preference == 'virtual'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CandidateChosen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="Candidate chosen" sourceRef="Gateway_CandidateChosen" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${candidateChosen}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="No candidate chosen" sourceRef="Gateway_CandidateChosen" targetRef="End_NoCandidateChosen">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${not candidateChosen}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferResponse" targetRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferResponse" targetRef="Event_ReceiveNegotiationRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveNegotiationRequest" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Event_ReceiveNegotiatedAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveNegotiatedAcceptance" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Task_ConductOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_ConductOrientation" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="End_FullyIntegrated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Offer acceptance" sourceRef="Participant_Candidates" targetRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" messageRef="Message_OfferAcceptance"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Hiring" name="Hiring and onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_NeedIdentified" name="Department identifies need for a new hire"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateJobDescription" name="HR creates job description"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostJobDescription" name="HR posts job description on job boards"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_CollectResumes" name="Collect resumes" messageRef="Message_Resume"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScreenResumes" name="Screen resumes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PhoneInterviews" name="Conduct initial phone interviews"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCandidates" name="Select candidates for in-person or virtual interviews"/>

    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InPersonInterview" name="Conduct in-person interview"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_VirtualInterview" name="Conduct virtual interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Merge interview formats"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseCandidate" name="Choose a candidate"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ExtendOffer" name="Extend offer" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Negotiation" name="Decide whether salary negotiations take place" default="Flow_NoNegotiation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateSalary" name="Negotiate salary"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" name="Merge negotiation paths"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" name="Receive offer acceptance">

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompletePaperwork" name="Complete onboarding paperwork"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductOrientation" name="Conduct orientation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_CreateJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CreateJobDescription" targetRef="Task_PostJobDescription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_PostJobDescription" targetRef="Task_CollectResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CollectResumes" targetRef="Task_ScreenResumes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_ScreenResumes" targetRef="Task_PhoneInterviews"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_PhoneInterviews" targetRef="Task_SelectCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_SelectCandidates" targetRef="Task_InviteCandidates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_InviteCandidates" targetRef="Event_ReceivePreference"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Event_ReceivePreference" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" name="In-person preference" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat" targetRef="Task_InPersonInterview">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Virtual preference" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewFormat" targetRef="Task_VirtualInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Candidate prefers a virtual interview</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_InPersonInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_VirtualInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Task_ChooseCandidate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ChooseCandidate" targetRef="Task_ExtendOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_ExtendOffer" targetRef="Gateway_Negotiation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" name="Negotiations take place" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation" targetRef="Task_NegotiateSalary">

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoNegotiation" name="No negotiations" sourceRef="Gateway_Negotiation" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateSalary" targetRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_NegotiationMerge" targetRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveAcceptance" targetRef="Task_CompletePaperwork"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_CompletePaperwork" targetRef="Task_ConductOrientation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_ConductOrientation" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="End_FullyIntegrated"/>
